The damage appears concentrated at/near the stem with characteristic stem rot/canker. This suggests candidates: Southern Blight, Phytophthora Blight, Sclerotinia Timber Rot, Bacterial Canker, or Alternaria Stem Cankers.

- The test image shows a bleached/tan dead main stem with branch collapse - classic Sclerotinia stem rot appearance
- Southern Blight showed white mycelium - not present in test
- Phytophthora Blight showed dark/black stem, not the bleached tan color in test
- Alternaria showed dark basal cankers, not matching
- Bacterial Canker showed leaf-margin necrosis, not matching
